title: Taylor Sheridan bought a 600-acre Texas ranch as a family home; it is now a film set, horse hub and concert venue
summary_full: Taylor Sheridan's Bosque Ranch in Weatherford, Texas, has transformed into a prominent site for film and TV productions. Originally intended as a family residence, it now generates substantial income through shows like Yellowstone and 1883. The ranch doubles as an equine center, celebrating Western culture with competitions and housing over 150 horses, making it a hotspot for equestrian training. Sheridan's strategic expansions have added to his impressive property portfolio.
